messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Final decision window: senior infra candidate — requires quick approval

Jonas, Laura —

Quick heads-up: Emilia (senior infra, interviewed last week) has given a hard deadline for her decision: Friday COB PT. She has a competing offer from an enterprise infra shop with a higher base, and her recruiter (Horizon) just sent a signed counter-proposal attached.

Recap:
- Candidate: Emilia Clarke (ex-Aperture Systems lead infra eng)
- Our current offer: $245k base, 15% target bonus, equity 0.5% (4-yr) — offer-letter-redwood-v2.docx attached
- Candidate counter: asking $265k base + 20% target + 0.65% equity; open to a signing bonus in lieu of full base lift (see emilia-counter-proposal.pdf)

As hiring manager I believe Emilia is high-impact and a good fit for the infra scale lead role. We have one headcount from Q4 hiring plan but the comp band sits at the top end. I need an explicit greenlight on either:
1) Approve one-time signing bonus (up to $25k) + 5% additional equity stretch (approved within band ceiling) OR
2) Approve a comp-band exception to raise base to $260k (limited term) + 0.5% equity.

If we can't move here I expect she will take the other offer. Please reply with whichever option you prefer or if you want me to loop in compensation/legal for a formal exception.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Staff Engineering Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachments: offer-letter-redwood-v2.docx

My initial read: I prefer option 1 (signing bonus + small equity stretch) so we don't permanently move the band. If Emilia pushes hard on base, we can consider a time-limited market adjustment but that requires compensation sign-off and headcount owner approval. Laura — would that be feasible from the hiring-plan side?

Jonas

Dylan/Jonas —

Option 1 is fine. Approve a one-time signing bonus up to $30k (so slightly above proposed) provided it is paid out over 6 months and documented in the offer appendix. Do not increase the base above ~$250k without a formal comp-band exception request to People & Compensation.

Also cc'ing PeopleOps for the paperwork (Stephanie) — please prepare the revised offer and include the payout schedule and a short justification paragraph about candidate scarcity and the competing offer. I want a clear audit trail if we go to comp-band exception later.

Laura

Thanks — I will draft the revised offer and appendix today. A few admin notes:
- Signing bonus up to $30,000 (gross) will be taxable; we'll put payout in two installments at 30 and 60 days post-start.
- Equity increase will be 0.05% extra (bringing total to 0.55%): that's within the manager-approved stretch cap.
- If we need to increase base above $250k later, PeopleOps needs a completed comp-band exception form + budget owner sign-off; that takes ~3 business days.

From: Emilia Clarke <emilia.clarke@gmail.com>

Cc: talent@horizonrecruiting.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Offer from Redwood — follow-up and firm window

Dylan —

Thanks for being candid. I appreciate Redwood's transparency and the revised terms you mentioned over the phone. I attached the formal counter from Horizon which outlines my ask and the timeline (emilia-counter-proposal.pdf). The competing offer is time-bound and they're asking me to confirm by Friday (Dec 4).

I care most about total comp and the ability to make an impact — equity and role scope matter as much as base. If you can match the base to $260k, that's the cleanest path for me. Otherwise the signing bonus + slightly more equity is workable but I'd prefer clarity on the promotion/comp review timeline (6–12 months) if we don't match base now.

Please let me know the final written offer by Thursday morning PT if possible — I want to make the best decision without burning bridges.

Best,
Emilia Clarke
(emilia-counter-proposal.pdf attached)

Subject: Re: Offer from Redwood — final revised offer enclosed

Emilia —

Thanks for the clear note and for giving us the context. We took the internal route (Laura + PeopleOps) and agreed to the following final package — please see the attached revised offer (offer-letter-redwood-v2.docx) and the signing bonus appendix:

- Base: $250,000
- Target bonus: 15%
- Signing bonus: $30,000 paid 50% at 30 days, 50% at 90 days post start
- Equity: 0.55% (4-year vest)
- Promotion/comp review: documented plan with manager at 6 months; formal review at 12 months with potential band re-evaluation contingent on impact and business need

We could not get to $260k base without a formal comp-band exception which would delay the offer by several days and risk losing the candidate given her Friday deadline. We believe this revised package is competitive and preserves band integrity. If this works, please sign the DocuSign envelope and we will expedite start-date logistics.

Welcome aboard (hopefully) — excited about what you'll build here.

Dylan
Staff Engineering Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachments: offer-letter-redwood-v2.docx, signing-bonus-appendix.pdf
